qwen_dpo.t: The error `RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded` occurs because the call stack in Python (and in most programming languages) has a limit on the number of recursive calls that can be made. This limit is known as the maximum recursion depth, and it is set to a comparatively small value (usually around 1000 in Python) to prevent a stack overflow. When the recursive function calls itself n times (such as in your Fibonacci function's case), it eventually reaches this limit, causing the call stack to overflow and resulting in the error.
